_comment: Peers relay node. Source of truth for the install script is install.sh; run ./build-egg.sh to regenerate egg-peers-node.json.
name: Peers Node
author: peers@peerstech.dev
description: An always-on relay node for Peers, the serverless E2E-encrypted messenger. Two people behind ordinary home routers cannot connect directly; this node gives them a rendezvous point, then gets out of the way once DCUtR hole-punches a direct connection. It only ever sees ciphertext and routing metadata.

variables.name: Install method
variables.description: 'source' builds the node from the git repository (slow — 10-25 minutes — but always works). 'release' downloads a prebuilt binary from GitHub Releases. NOTE: PeersTech/Peers has not published any releases yet, so 'release' will fail with an explanatory message until one is cut. Leave this on 'source'.

variables.name: Git ref
variables.description: Branch, tag or commit to build when INSTALL_METHOD is 'source'. Pin this to a tag or commit SHA for a reproducible node; 'main' moves under you.

variables.name: Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository to build from. Change only if you maintain a fork.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: The address clients will dial. Set 'auto' to detect it at boot, or enter the IP directly. REQUIRED on almost every host: containers see only an internal address, so without this the node advertises something unreachable and no client can use it. Leave blank only if the container genuinely holds a public IP on its own interface.

variables.name: Announce override
variables.description: Advanced. Full comma-separated multiaddrs to advertise, e.g. /ip4/1.2.3.4/tcp/4001,/ip4/1.2.3.4/udp/4001/quic-v1 — without the /p2p/<id> suffix. Overrides Public IP entirely. Use for IPv6, DNS names, or when the external port differs from the container's port.

variables.name: Upstream nodes
variables.description: Optional. Comma-separated multiaddrs of other Peers nodes to dial and reserve relay slots on, so nodes can chain. Each must include the /p2p/<peer-id> suffix.

variables.name: Disable relaying
variables.description: Set to 1 to forward nothing. This turns off the only reason to run a node, so leave it at 0 unless you are deliberately running a DHT-only participant on a metered connection.

variables.name: Build parallelism
variables.description: cargo build --jobs. Linking a Tauri binary is memory-hungry; lower this to 1 if the install is killed partway through.
